notes: Fixes the auto-updater for real this time. The swap was being run from the Electron binary inside the portable build's temporary unpack folder — the folder the portable launcher deletes the moment FleetComm exits. Our own shutdown was killing the updater mid-swap, every time, with no error and no window: you just reopened the old version. The swap now runs under Windows' own PowerShell, which we cannot delete, and it writes a log to your FleetComm app-data folder so a failure can actually be diagnosed. A blocked relaunch also no longer rolls back a successful install.
